# Change Wallpaper

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Changes the devices wallpaper.

## Syntax

~~~~text
changeWallpaper(image: <#Variable (Optional)#>, location: <#Enumeration Array (Optional)#>, preview: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
changeWallpaper(image: ShortcutInput, location: , preview: )
~~~~
